methods_quotes.q: Results from these analyses were aggregated and weighted by the size of the IDU population in each MSA
For city-level estimates for which confidence intervals could not be calculated, maximally wide confidence intervals (0–1) were used in aggregation.
City-level estimates with inadequate sample size for analysis (five or fewer observations) were excluded from aggregation.
